Based on the analysis:

- Zone_F3_Z01 (Core_mid) shows a sharp step change from 2018-06 (23.51 C) to 2018-07 (25.13 C) and then stays essentially flat at ~25.1 C through December, even during winter months (Oct 25.15, Nov 25.12, Dec 25.11).
- Every other F3 zone and adjacent zones shows a normal seasonal pattern — peaking in summer (24.6-25.0 C), dropping in winter (22-23 C).
- A local increase in load would still produce a seasonal trace (heated in winter to the heating setpoint ~18.6 C, cooled in summer). Instead, F3Z01 is essentially pinned near the cooling setpoint (25.2 C) year-round, including deep winter. That signature — an abnormally flat, non-seasonal reading pinned at one value — is consistent with a zone sensor fault, not a physical load change.
